scenario: LLOG.2.7.2 / LFAC.1.7 relation (key=all). Consumes{step key, product key} marks every slot `key`, so distinct (step, product) tuples are distinct facts that coexist — a multi-input step does not collapse to one input. Pin: assert (1,"x") and (1,"y") → both coexist → the rule fires for each → two firings; re-asserting (1,"x") coalesces (identical tuple, LLOG.2.7.1) → no third firing.

    product: String key
